author: source_route
body:
Well it seems that Avicus has had an update. Lets go into detail. All xp is lost and prestiges and now you need credits (raindrops basically) to get badges. New gamemodes like legacy? And, TDM. The first time I logged on to see the new update was at 10pm when those 2 gamemodes had 6 people in them, meaning during the day they have ~10-15, following avicus. Then we have an unnecessarily large lobby, like the one that removed along time ago. We have sg, like every single mc server ever.
Into more detail, the only reason we had this update was to get more people on avicus. With atractive building, simple textures, and a ton of gamemodes. Avicus more like blatant OCN knock off.
So, look back in the past. The old buggy glitchy avicus (the 2 things that made it fun). Where you could stay on for hours just becuase you couldn't kill that one guy. Or, how you could know every one in a lobby. Be mad at me all you want, its just an opinion

replies.body:
I like the entire update except how it's on 1.8 (used to get around 130 now I'm lucky to get 19) and how Nebula is separated into separate gamemodes.

SG IS unoriginal, but I like how we have custom maps and not the same 20 maps on every single server.

Credits is cool, several other servers had it before OCN and even THOSE servers copied from something.
